voice.caption: Give me more, freely — and here is your gift, Nobody, to warm your heart: I eat Nobody last, after all his friends. There is my guest-gift to you.

voice.speaker: odysseus
voice.caption: Odysseus heats the stake until it glows and the chosen men drive it into the Cyclops's eye.

voice.speaker: odysseus
voice.caption: Odysseus twist it as blood and steam erupt.
Polyphemus wakes with a roar and tears it free.

What ails you, Polyphemus, that you wake the deathless night with screaming — is some man stealing your flocks, or killing you by craft or force? If Nobody harms you, alone as you are, it is sickness sent by Zeus, and cannot be helped — pray to your father Poseidon.
Polyphemus gropes at the entrance while the men hide among the animals.

keys.beat: Polyphemus drinks three bowls, promises Nobody the last death as a guest-gift, and collapses.
Odysseus heats the stake until it glows and the chosen men drive it into the Cyclops's eye.
They twist it as blood and steam erupt; Polyphemus wakes with a roar and tears it free.
Other Cyclopes call from outside, but leave when he says Nobody is killing him.
Polyphemus gropes at the entrance while the men hide among the animals.
